name: Nem nuong Cai Rang
summary: Nem nướng Cái Răng is skewers of lean pork grilled over charcoal, with peanut sauce, herbs, pickles, and bánh hỏi. Vietnam Tourism’s four-day piece eats it back in town after the market. The place page’s Phong Điền fine rice vermicelli is the noodle that goes with this kind of plate.
origin: Cái Răng, eaten back in town at lunch on the four-day piece.
howToEat: With bánh hỏi, herbs, and the sauce, at lunch after the market.
where: Back in town after Cái Răng. A shop name is not part of the plate.
seoDescription: Charcoal pork skewers with peanut sauce, herbs, pickles, and bánh hỏi, eaten in town after the Cái Răng boats.
